news.summary: Among nearly 4,500 evaluated hospitals, the highly watched annual accolades awarded 16% some form of "Best Hospitals" designation.

news.title: Amid spending growth scrutiny, CMS unveils toolkit for states to safeguard autism care
news.summary: The toolkit does not establish new federal requirements or endorse any single treatment approach to applied behavior analysis (ABA). Instead, CMS says it gives states practical tools to ensure every child gets individualized, evidence-based care.

news.title: HCA Healthcare acquires 40 Texas urgent care centers
news.summary: The deal sees the facilities rebranded as CareNow sites, and many are being tied to the existing footprint of two affiliate systems.

news.title: Complete Health to pay $14.1M in Medicare Advantage coding misuse allegations settlement
news.summary: The settlement resolves allegations from 2020 to 2023 that the company submitted HCCs that were "not clinically valid" or not supported by medical records or treatment plans.

news.title: Amae Health teams up with Google Health to integrate wearables data into SMI care
news.summary: Amae’s long-term goal is to develop a predictive model that pulls on wearables and other data to measure disease state and progression and spot early warning signs of clinical decline.

news.title: Daffodil Health unveils AI-powered payer platform for managing NSA disputes
news.summary: AI health tech company Daffodil Health is rolling out a new platform aimed at supporting payers in managing the No Surprises Act dispute process.

news.title: QuantHealth raises $45M series B to accelerate AI-driven clinical trial simulations
news.summary: The company plans to use the fresh capital to advance its R&D, grow its team and expand its product portfolio, CEO and co-founder Orr Inbar told Fierce Healthcare.

news.title: Startup Claryx launches out of stealth to tackle the $45B challenge of hospital-acquired infections
news.summary: Startup Claryx is taking a novel approach to pathogen detection, using environmental and genomic intelligence to support hospital infection prevention programs. The company is building an immune system for hospitals, one that catches transmission while it's happening.

news.title: Cleveland Clinic, Zipline take flight with prescription drug drone delivery partnership
news.summary: Cleveland Clinic and Zipline have taken to the skies with their drone-delivery partnership for prescription drugs. It marks the first long-term deployment of a prescription drug drone delivery by a health system, they said, with the first deliveries made last week in and around Beachwood.

news.title: Why payers should have these 3 pipeline drugs on their radar
news.summary: Optum Rx's latest look at the drug development pipeline highlights three drugs for rare and chronic conditions that payers and plan sponsors should be watching.

news.title: Democratic AGs file suit challenging 2027 ACA rule

news.title: Senate appropriators unveil stopgap funding bill that blocks Trump's attempt to change science funding
news.summary: Senators on the Appropriations Committee on Sunday released a stopgap funding bill to avert a government shutdown by Oct. 1 and temporarily block a White House proposal that would fundamentally change how the federal government awards and manages grants.

news.title: Icon inks Anthropic partnership to deploy Claude into clinical trials
news.summary: Contract research organization Icon announced a multi-year collaboration with Anthropic this week to bring Claude’s AI capabilities to clinical trials.

news.title: Amgen drops early-stage obesity drug, upping pressure on MariTide
news.summary: Amgen has ended development of its early-stage obesity drug AMG 513, foisting its hopes for a slice of the massive weight loss market onto the shoulders of phase 3 candidate MariTide.

news.title: Smith & Nephew cuts 2026 outlook as US knee implant sales slide
news.summary: Smith & Nephew has lowered its 2026 sales outlook after weakness in U.S. orthopedics and wound care outweighed stronger growth in sports medicine.

news.title: Fiercest Women in Life Sciences 2026: Nominations open now
news.summary: Who should be a 2026 Fiercest Woman in Life Sciences? Nominations are open for women making an impact across pharma, biotech, medtech and beyond. The deadline is Sept. 18.

news.title: Lisata lays off 72% of staffers, sues Kuva after planned merger falls apart
news.summary: Lisata is laying off 72% of its workforce, including its chief medical officer, as the solid tumor biotech tries to navigate a new future after a planned merger with cancer imaging company Kuva Labs fell apart.

news.title: KKR inks $5.7B deal to take medtech manufacturing giant Integer private
news.summary: Private equity giant KKR is expanding its healthcare portfolio with a deal to take medtech manufacturing giant Integer private for approximately $5.7 billion.

news.title: Pfizer axes ex-Metsera obesity asset and GIPR prospect in quarterly clearout
news.summary: Pfizer has axed two clinical-stage obesity programs, dropping a GLP-1 receptor agonist from the Metsera buyout and a GIPR antagonist as part of its quarterly pipeline cleanout.

news.title: Latigo laces up for $247M IPO to fund non-opioid pain drug rival to Vertex’s Journavx
news.summary: Latigo Biotherapeutics has fleshed out its plans for an IPO to finance the development of its clinical-stage pipeline of non-opioid pain management drugs.

news.title: Pathos AI pads pipeline with $2.2B Alphamab deal, AstraZeneca pact
news.summary: Pathos AI has agreed to pay $125 million for a bispecific antibody-drug conjugate from China’s Alphamab Oncology, while adding a Big Pharma partner in the form of AstraZeneca.

news.title: Merck’s $11B anti-TL1A bet delivers 1 win, 1 loss in midphase inflammatory disease trials
news.summary: A phase 2 trial of Merck & Co.’s anti-TL1A monoclonal antibody has missed its primary endpoint, closing off one avenue for expansion of an asset acquired in a $10.8 billion takeover. The setback was offset by a midphase win in another indication.

news.title: Curium strikes up to $8B deal for radiopharma rival Lantheus
news.summary: Months after reports first linked Curium to a potential Lantheus takeover, the radiopharma players have made it official with a deal worth up to $8 billion.

news.title: BlossomHill eyes $112M IPO harvest to bankroll potential Tagrisso challenger
news.summary: BlossomHill Therapeutics plans to raise $111.7 million to fund the clinical journey of its potential challenger to Tagrisso.

papers.title: GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience
papers.summary: A wearable assistant should both answer questions about its visual history and recognize when that history is useful to the present situation. Existing video-memory systems primarily support question-conditioned recall, whereas proactive assistants typically use separate memory and control mechanisms. We introduce GROVE, a training-free framework that supports both behaviors with one memory grown causally from a continuous video stream. GROVE retains fine-grained perceptual evidence and incrementally consolidates it into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring cross-day patterns

papers.title: Loud or Silent? A Reusable Framework for Per-Modality Failure Analysis in Multimodal Clinical AI
papers.summary: Multimodal clinical models are usually judged on accuracy with every modality present, but deployment removes modalities; an echocardiogram is often unavailable where an ECG is routine. Two questions then matter beyond the size of the accuracy loss: which modality was responsible, and whether the model fails loudly or silently once that modality is dropped. The distinction is per-example and modality-level, and is separate from post-hoc feature attribution (e.g. SHAP). Models are replaced often; the evaluation that answers these questions is reused. papers.title: Seeing or Knowing? Visual Context Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance by integrating visual inputs with the rich priors of pretrained language models. However, they often fail on vision-centric tasks, especially when visual evidence conflicts with pretrained knowledge. We explore these failures separately using two diagnostic paradigms: (1) probing whether visual information is available, via image reconstruction, and (2) measuring multimodal context sensitivity, the extent to which the model follows visual context versus the language prior.
